sloka: तं भूमौ पितुरार्तेन न्यस्तं रामेण वीक्ष्य सा ।उवाच देवी कौसल्या सर्वा दशरथस्त्रिय: ॥ २.१०३.९॥
transliteration: taṁ bhūmau piturārtena nyastaṁ rāmeṇa vīkṣya sā ।uvāca devī kausalyā sarvā daśarathastriya: ॥ 2.103.9॥

translations.english: Seeing the pinda (edible offering made to the departed soul) placed on the ground for his father by the distressed Rama, queen Kausalya, addressing all the wives of Dasaratha, said:
